description: This Python source file defines asynchronous functions for managing activities related to projects and tasks within a collaborative platform. It includes functions for recording activities, retrieving activity feeds, and verifying project membership, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM models and async database sessions.

methods.name: Project _ensure_project_member(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int)
methods.description: Checks if a user is a member (owner or member profile) of the specified project, raising HTTP errors if not.

methods.name: Activity record_activity( db: AsyncSession, *, project_id: int, actor_id: int, type: str, message: str, task_id: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Records an activity event for a project, optionally associating it with a task, and commits it to the database.

methods.name: List[Activity] get_project_activity(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, user_id: int, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent activities for a specific project, verifying user membership.

methods.name: List[Activity] get_task_activity(db: AsyncSession, project_id: int, task_id: int, user_id: int, limit: int = 50)
methods.description: Retrieves a list of recent activities for a specific task within a project, verifying user membership and task existence.
